section_index.title: Here you can watch a quick showcase of what you would expect from (giga) high investment into Penance Brand of Dissipation in the really late game, speed, clear, single target damage, tankiness, etc .. a well rounded build !

What is Penance Brand of Dissipation & how to scale it Brands are a type of skill which create persistent spells that can be attached to an enemy. Your Brand attachment range will affect how far your brand can be attached to an enemy, it's one of the reasons for our clear & comfiness, having decent brand range. I talk a bit more about brand range in the section [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LgmXoA7LxmWiiMN2wYrV4FAtPmHBN3bLX6lfLv6VUY/edit#bookmark=id.w6h6fxz5htf2).
💡 Defence & life in early stage of the build
Defence & life in early stage of the build

Defence at the beginning is not my main focus at all but I also don't enjoy playing a build which dies on every single hit taken. Path of Exile’s defence for a lot of people is one tapping everything and not getting hit once, it's true and false at the same time.
💡 How to convert last physical part of Penance

Physical to lightning support gem allows you to convert 50% of physical to lightning for linked active skill, and it also gives some physical as extra lightning damage. It is a really good choice if you don't have access to the other sources of conversion, the early & easy way to fix conversion on penance but it does require a gem slot and so there are better ways to convert later when you have more resources. Lightning mastery can give you up to 40% convert phys to light Gloves : You can bench craft a prefix on gloves to get up to 25% conversion, and the veiled version of this modifier goes up to 35%
Mid game (red map/atlas bosses) With this pob you should be pretty comfortable in mapping & regular bossing

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide targets mid-to-advanced players economically. It presents Penance Brand Inquisitor as a build that can start a league but has a very high endgame ceiling and many meaningful upgrades.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Do not pitch this as a low-budget beginner build. Treat it as a scaling project with staged upgrades.

knowledge_cards.summary: Penance Brand of Dissipation is treated as a physical-base brand spell with partial lightning conversion, stack ramp, and strong uptime. The guide emphasizes duration and cast speed because faster activation reaches high stacks earlier and keeps full-stack uptime longer.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: When evaluating a PBoD PoB, inspect conversion, duration, cast speed, brand count, and full-DPS configuration before judging DPS.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide lists early Physical to Lightning Support as the easy conversion fix, then replaces it later through lightning mastery, glove craft/veiled or Eater implicit, Wrath Watcher's Eye, or Glorious Vanity notable conversion.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Flag Physical to Lightning Support as acceptable early but not the preferred long-term socket if gear/tree conversion is available.

knowledge_cards.summary: Early defense relies on safe brand play, freezing, leech/regen, endurance-charge-on-kill ring tech, CWDT Immortal Call, and a reasonable life plus ES pool. Damage is prioritized until the character is comfortable.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: For early deaths, check life on jewels, Glorious Vanity/Corrupted Soul timing, leech, endurance charge ring, Death Rush, phasing, and double-brand quality of life.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide recommends staying Armageddon Brand until Uber Lab or a strong transition package is ready. Suggested minimum swap package includes Inpulsa, pseudo-5L Shaper helmet, dual large clusters, triple Remarkable medium clusters, Uber Lab, and upgraded Brine King for freeze immunity.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Do not recommend an early Penance swap unless the player has the transition package or understands the damage/clear risk.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide's post-leveling priority is Inpulsa, corrupted-blood jewel, pseudo-6L helmet, weapon, amulet, boots, level 21 Penance, Storm's Gift, double large plus medium clusters, then Glorious Vanity for comfortable atlas completion.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Use this order as a brand-specific upgrade lane when coaching weak early atlas PBoD characters.

knowledge_cards.summary: Midgame adds Glorious Vanity/Corrupted Soul, improves medium clusters, changes conversion so Physical to Lightning can be dropped, adds reservation tools for another aura, and uses Death Rush for mapping speed/defense.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: If the build has midgame currency but still uses early sockets, check whether conversion and reservation upgrades allow a better support gem/aura package.

knowledge_cards.summary: Endgame branches include armour/ES, evasion/suppress, and block versions, each with non-Mageblood and Mageblood PoBs. The 8L helmet is a major damage step and is described as expensive and RNG-heavy.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: When recommending endgame upgrades, ask whether the user wants clear, defense, bossing, or Mageblood path before selecting a branch.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide flags elemental reflect, less/no recovery, cannot be slowed, and stacked rippy damage mods as problematic. It suggests Soul of Yugul plus Sibyl's Lament for elemental reflect or Atziri reflect handling.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Expose these as map warnings in farming/atlas coaching for PBoD Inquisitor.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide expects PoB configuration to include low life, flask state, recent crit/ignite/chill/shock, consecrated ground, active/attached brands set to 2, enemy ailment state, RF not Vaal RF, and Penance Full DPS count 2.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Before comparing DPS, validate the PoB config instead of trusting the displayed number directly.

knowledge_cards.summary: The guide is cautious about SSF and says Penance does not feel good without explode sources. It points to separate SSF brand expertise rather than claiming the trade-league path maps cleanly to SSF.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: For SSF users, lower confidence and require an explode-source plan before recommending direct PBoD progression.
